headline: Governed commercial master data that Sales, Marketing, Market Access, and Patient Services can all trust.
pitch: I build and govern commercial data systems, and I do the hands-on work myself. At flyExclusive I led a CRM data transformation on HubSpot Enterprise: governance rules, about 300 contact properties consolidated to 100 governed sources of truth, deduplication, identity resolution, and Master Data Management. I run the ETL and daily data jobs on Azure, manage the outside agency that runs our digital ad buying, and built conversational reporting that the whole executive team and sales team use. Before that, at TRANZACT, a health and Medicare insurance marketer, I worked with CRM data under HIPAA, deciding what could be used for analytics and marketing and what had to be anonymized, and ran ETL on Databricks. I'm in Raleigh, a short drive from Cary.

requirements.need: Lead MDM initiatives so customer and master data are accurate and governed
requirements.evidence: At flyExclusive I set up Master Data Management on HubSpot Enterprise: consolidated about 300 contact properties down to 100 governed sources of truth, built deduplication workflows and identity resolution (merging duplicate contacts and companies across sources), and enforced ownership rules and lifecycle stages. My records have been consumer and business customers rather than HCPs, HCOs, and payers.

requirements.need: Define data definitions, business rules, stewardship processes, and data-quality controls
requirements.evidence: I wrote flyExclusive's CRM governance standards and ownership rules, and cleaned a list of about 500,000 contacts down to the ~85,000 that could be marketed to compliantly. On this site I built a taxonomy enforced in code: every record is checked against controlled values, and failures are flagged and counted by rule instead of silently dropped.

requirements.need: Design scalable commercial data architecture and translate commercial priorities into a data roadmap
requirements.evidence: I designed flyExclusive's CRM data architecture, migrated the website off a legacy CMS with pipelines feeding quotes into the CRM, and replaced Tableau and Airtable to consolidate the stack. I'm now leading the move from HubSpot to an in-house tool, which means sequencing a roadmap around live sales operations.

requirements.need: Enterprise data warehousing, ETL, and cloud platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS)
requirements.evidence: I build and run the ETL and daily data jobs on Azure at flyExclusive, and did the same on Databricks at TRANZACT. SQL daily, plus Python pipelines and REST API integrations, and I've worked in BigQuery. I haven't run Snowflake, AWS, or Zaidyn in production.

requirements.need: BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and SQL, Python, R
requirements.evidence: Tableau and Power BI; SQL and Python (pandas, scikit-learn) daily. I redesigned flyExclusive's leadership dashboards and built conversational reporting that the entire executive leadership team and sales team use to ask questions of the data directly. I replaced Tableau and Airtable with tools I built myself.

requirements.need: Partner with Sales Ops/BI, Marketing, Sales and IT; lead cross-functional projects such as segmentation and omnichannel performance
requirements.evidence: I report to flyExclusive's Chief Commercial Officer, present build priorities monthly, and have managed the ~20-person retail sales team on an interim basis. When sales leadership wanted to email the biggest list possible despite a "Bad" domain reputation, I made the case for engaged, opted-in contacts only, and open rates doubled. At TRANZACT I ran segmentation, multi-touch attribution, and an A/B testing program (50% win rate, 30% CTR improvement), and delivered analytics to partner carriers.

requirements.need: Understanding of data automation and AI-driven analytics
requirements.evidence: I built an LLM enrichment pipeline wired into flyExclusive's CRM that has enriched about 500,000 records and powers lead scoring; personalized outreach from it gets a 150% better response rate. On this site I built a retrieval-augmented chat with an automated eval harness. I build with AI coding tools daily.

requirements.need: Manage the commercial data managed service provider and data vendors
requirements.evidence: At flyExclusive I manage the outside marketing agency that handles all of our digital ad buying (about $300K a month) and a ~$500K-a-year marketing tools budget. I write a PRD and get sign-off before every build, and run work in Microsoft Planner with named reviewers and deadlines. An outsourced data team would be new; I'd set scope, SLAs, and an issue log in the first month.

requirements.need: 4+ years in pharma commercial data; syndicated data (IQVIA, Symphony, MMIT, specialty pharmacy, 852/867); HIPAA and GDPR
requirements.evidence: I've worked under HIPAA: at TRANZACT, a health and Medicare insurance marketer, I decided what CRM data could be used for analytics and marketing and what had to be anonymized. I haven't worked in pharma or with syndicated data (IQVIA, Symphony, MMIT, 852/867). The structures are familiar (customer master, channel data, reconciliation), and I'd learn each feed and how it reconciles to shipments and the CRM first.

featured.title: PodFlow — pipeline end to end
featured.blurb: My M.S. capstone: ingestion into Postgres, transcription, a trained segmentation model, LLM enrichment, and an offline evaluation framework, built solo.

featured.title: Resume Chat — grounded AI answers
featured.blurb: AI answers drawn only from one governed source of truth and checked by an automated eval, the pattern for AI-driven analytics on trusted data.
